topic_name: Looking for Repeats Around Us
title: Four pictures side by side
description: Four flat drawings in a row, a rangoli, a butterfly, a paper windmill and a cloud, under the word Symmetry, with no marks on them.

topic_name: Mirror Halves and the Line of Symmetry
title: Fold and see if it matches
description: A triangle folded along its dotted middle line whose halves match exactly, next to joined puzzle pieces with a bump and a flat edge that do not match.

topic_name: Mirror Halves and the Line of Symmetry
title: Left side matches right side
description: A Taj Mahal outline with a middle dotted line and mirror matching tinted halves, next to a cloud outline whose two sides differ.

topic_name: Many Lines of Symmetry
title: A square has four fold lines
description: Four equal teal squares in a row, each with one dashed fold line: upright, across and the two diagonals, numbered 1 to 4.

topic_name: Many Lines of Symmetry
title: Count only exact matches
description: Three designs in a row: a spiky ring with 6 fold lines, a twisted six-petal flower with none, and a looped design with a square centre and 4 fold lines.

topic_name: Many Lines of Symmetry
title: Rectangle diagonal does not fold
description: A teal rectangle 6 cm by 3 cm with corners A to D and a dashed diagonal that does not fold onto itself, next to an amber square with its diagonal that does.

topic_name: Reflection Symmetry
title: Corners cross the mirror line
description: A square split by a vertical dashed mirror line, teal on the left and amber on the right, with level arrows from A to B and from D to C crossing the line.

topic_name: Reflection Symmetry
title: Corners on the line stay
description: A teal square with a dashed diagonal AC, corners A and C circled as staying, and a double arrow between B and D showing they swap.

topic_name: Making Symmetric Shapes: Ink, Folds and Cuts
title: Ink blot on a folded sheet
description: An opened sheet with a vertical crease and a teal ink blot that is the same on both sides of the crease.

topic_name: Making Symmetric Shapes: Ink, Folds and Cuts
title: A cut repeats across the fold
description: A folded teal sheet with one notch on the folded edge, and the same sheet opened with a diamond hole made of the notch and its mirror image on the fold line.

topic_name: Making Symmetric Shapes: Ink, Folds and Cuts
title: Eight lines of symmetry
description: A teal eight pointed star with four amber lines through opposite tips and four reddish purple lines through opposite dips, 8 in all.

topic_name: Rotational Symmetry and Angles of Symmetry
title: A quarter turn of a rangoli
description: Two identical teal rangolis with 4 petals around a ring, joined by a curved arrow marked 90 degrees.

topic_name: Rotational Symmetry and Angles of Symmetry
title: Four turns fit a square
description: A teal square with a centre dot and a quarter turn arrow, beside four small squares showing the corner tick after 90, 180, 270 and 360 degrees.

topic_name: Rotational Symmetry and Angles of Symmetry
title: A strip that does not fit
description: A teal strip with a 2 cm top and 4 cm bottom, and the same strip turned 180 degrees in amber over a dotted old outline, clearly not matching.

topic_name: Radial Arms: Turning 4, 2 and 3 Ways
title: Four arms, four turns
description: A four armed teal windmill with one red arm and a quarter turn arrow, beside the list 90, 180, 270 and 360 degrees.

topic_name: Radial Arms: Turning 4, 2 and 3 Ways
title: Keep only two turns
description: Three copies of a four armed figure: the start, the half turned copy which matches, and the quarter turned copy which does not.

topic_name: Radial Arms: Turning 4, 2 and 3 Ways
title: Make the gaps equal
description: A three armed figure with gaps 100, 120 and 140 degrees on the left, and on the right the same figure with three equal gaps of 120 degrees.

topic_name: Order and the Smallest Angle of Symmetry
title: The blue shape repeats
description: A hexagon with a teal triangle on each of its 6 sides, all turned the same way, and a tracing of one triangle at the side.

topic_name: Order and the Smallest Angle of Symmetry
title: Steps of the smallest angle
description: A number line of turns with teal dots at 90, 180, 270 and 360 degrees, and a crossed amber circle at 100 degrees.

topic_name: Symmetries of a Circle
title: A circle has no smallest turn
description: A teal square with a 90 degree turn arrow beside an amber circle with a tiny turn arrow, showing the circle has no smallest turn.

topic_name: Symmetries of a Circle
title: Every diameter folds a circle
labels: Every diameter is a mirror line
description: A teal circle with three diameters through its centre, one vertical and two slanted, 60 degrees apart.

topic_name: Symmetries of a Circle
title: Turns that look the same
description: A three bladed fan, a five petal flower and an eight spoke wheel, each with its smallest turn: 120, 72 and 45 degrees.

topic_name: Playing with Tiles and a Symmetry Game
title: Mirror the quarter twice
labels: Each quarter is a mirror picture
description: A 4 by 4 grid of teal and amber triangle tiles with two red lines crossing at the middle; each quarter mirrors its neighbour.

topic_name: Playing with Tiles and a Symmetry Game
title: Reply with the half turn
description: A 6 by 6 grid with a teal line in row 2, columns 2 and 3, and the purple reply in row 5, columns 4 and 5, a half turn about the amber centre dot.
